How I work

From pixel to profit

Track

Install the pixel and purchase events first, so results are measured, not guessed.

Test

Launch several audiences and creatives with small budgets and compare them fairly.

Analyze

Read ROAS, CPA, CR and AOV per ad set to find the real winners.

Scale

Move budget into the winners, duplicate them, and keep testing new angles.
